snippet.title: VMX Early Access - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
This is the official announcement trailer for VMX, the most realistic VR BMX title for VR. 

Wishlist now for the quest 
https://vr.meta.me/s/1M6o82svGEv0vGj
Wishlist now for steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3554630/VMX/

🔥 VMX - The Ultimate Extreme Sports Game! 🚲🛴🏆

Get ready to ride like never before! VMX brings you the most authentic extreme sports experience, whether you're shredding on a Slopestyle MTB, BMX, or Stunt Scooter! With gesture-based tricks, precise bike handling, and realistic physics, every session feels like the real deal.

🌟 Key Features:
✅ Ride BMX, MTB & Stunt Scooters in epic skateparks & dirt tracks
✅ Master insane tricks with an intuitive gesture-based system
✅ Customize your ride with a realistic spray-painting tool
✅ Challenge yourself in skill-based levels & free roam modes
✅ Style your rider with fresh outfits & gear

If you love Descenders, Riders Republic, Pipe BMX, Skater XL, or Session, VMX is your next thing 🎮🔥

🔔 Subscribe & hit the bell for more updates on VMX!
👍 Like & comment if you’re hyped to drop in!

  We are a small indie team trying to create something extreme in the world of VR. We have developed the game in unreal engine 5.

Check out our socials, or find more about the game at 
https://vmxgame.com

https://www.tiktok.com/@breakfreeinteractive
https://www.instagram.com/breakfreeinteractive/

Harvio /  SI A MI / courtesy of www.epidemicsound.com
